answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens for ten epochs before its votes count, and peers check that the bond came from a wallet with its own earning history, not a fresh mirror of another account. A farm of 100 fakes therefore freezes 50,000 tokens and waits the full horizon, while splitting one purse across many wallets fails the history check. An honest agent locks its bond once and gets it back intact, so its crystal record of good work costs it nothing extra.
